name: RXK Nephew
description:
RXK Nephew (RXKNephew), the Rochester, New York rapper behind “American Tterroristt”, and his Sep 2026 call with the Nigerian Bitcoin crew, “Uncle RXKNEPHEW goes on NIGERIAN Podcast”, where he was asked about Bitcoin Obama.
Rapper; podcast guest.
In September 2026 he joined a Discord call with three members of the Nigerian “Bitcoin” crew, Bitcoin Theo Von, Bitcoin Robin Williams and Adeleke.

Facts (Bitcoin Obama Wiki, https://bitcoinobama.com/rxknephew):
- RXK Nephew (also written RXKNephew; formerly Rx Nephew and DrugRixh Nephew) is an American rapper, songwriter and record producer from Rochester, New York, known for his enormous release rate, his stream-of-consciousness style and the nine-minute 2020 song “American Tterroristt”.
- In September 2026 he joined a Discord call with three members of the Nigerian “Bitcoin” crew, Bitcoin Theo Von, Bitcoin Robin Williams and Adeleke.
- Cryptoiscrack released the call on Sep 29, 2026 on the YouTube channel of The Crypto Craic Podcast as “Uncle RXKNEPHEW goes on NIGERIAN Podcast”.
- During it the crew told him about Bitcoin Obama, whom he took at first to be Barack Obama.
- RXK Nephew posts on X as @nephewrxk.
- Guest on a YouTube-only episode where the crew asked him about Bitcoin Obama.
- RXK Nephew is Rapper; podcast guest.
- Also written: RXKNephew, Rx Nephew, DrugRixh Nephew; alter ego Slitherman
- Born: February 1, 1995 per Wikipedia (he said “born in 1994” on the call)
- Origin: Rochester, New York
- Occupation: Rapper, songwriter, record producer
- Known for: “American Tterroristt” (2020); Slitherman Activated (2021); hundreds of songs a year
- Collaborator: Rx Papi (as Neph & Pap)
- Relationship to Bitcoin Obama: Guest on a YouTube-only episode where the crew asked him about Bitcoin Obama

entries.content: Bitcoin Obama is a Nigerian crypto shiller and meme personality on X, known since May 2023. He is NOT Barack Obama and has no connection to him.
entries.name: Bitcoin Obama

entries.content: His name comes from the coin he shills: HarryPotterObamaSonic10Inu (HPOS10I), an Ethereum meme coin whose ticker is $BITCOIN. It is not Bitcoin ($BTC).
entries.name: HPOS10I

entries.content: He is the star of The Crypto Craic Podcast, billed as the official Bitcoin Obama podcast, hosted by @Cryptoiscrack, his biggest inducer.
